dct_title_s: Woodbury County, Iowa, 1955, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKV. Form of individual image numbering: BKV-1N-[number], BKV-2N-[number], or BKV-3N-[number]. "Flying completed 8-12-55". Flown by Puckett Aerial Surveys, Inc. Louisville, Kentucky. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
